phone.changelog: v3.3.48: Movies fixed — movibox streams routed through VPS proxy (CDN rejects headerless video requests).

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: Player overhaul: LEFT/RIGHT D-pad now SEEKS (tap = ±10s, HOLD = continuous scan), web embed controls hidden so only our OSD shows, seek bar + timestamp always visible above buttons, dead-title 404 failover (auto-tries next server instead of the Content-not-found wall), provider strip (Netflix/Prime) now scrolls with D-pad, Kids row fixed (Doraemon plays), OSD no longer overlaps or clips off-screen, unmute-on-start. Audio boost defaults to 300% (streams were too quiet); system music volume raised on start.
